attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Refactors recipe step parsing to a shared base/extension with backward-compatible 'Indices'->'Indexes' property handling, but relies on 'Indices' setter only being applied when non-empty (order-dependent JSON deserialization) which could silently drop old-format recipes if Indexes is set after Indices with empty list, warranting a careful review though behavior is largely preserved."}

reason: Refactors recipe step parsing to a shared base/extension with backward-compatible 'Indices'->'Indexes' property handling, but relies on 'Indices' setter only being applied when non-empty (order-dependent JSON deserialization) which could silently drop old-format recipes if Indexes is set after Indices with empty list, warranting a careful review though behavior is largely preserved.
